name: @cc/dsh-rtk
description: Command-aware output compression for shell tools: maps a simple command to an `rtk pipe -f` filter, replaces an oversized model-facing text result with rtk's compact projection plus a banner naming the filter and the recovery route, and contributes one system-prompt section that says where the rtk binary is and how to prefix a command for full control. It never rewrites arguments and never filters a result it does not understand.
